In detail

Rotterdam Zuid across the Maas: Kop van Zuid and the Erasmusbrug at one end, Hillesluis and the Afrikaanderwijk behind it. Rotterdam runs a Veiligheidsindex as part of its Wijkprofiel, built from crime and nuisance figures together with a survey of around 30,000 residents between March and October 2025. Citywide it fell from 110 in 2022 to 104 in 2026, with the perception of safety dropping faster than the recorded figures. Hillesluis is one of five focus areas whose Veiligheidsindex rose against the citywide trend, and it exceeded the council's own expectations — so the direction here is the opposite of the city's. Kop van Zuid is a regenerated waterfront; the older streets inland are where the work is still being done.

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Rotterdam publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Feijenoord safe?

Wandroz currently rates Feijenoord in Rotterdam as an area where the review found nothing traveller-relevant to report during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Is Feijenoord safe at night?

At night, Feijenoord is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Feijenoord a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Feijenoord's day rating (an area where the review found nothing traveller-relevant to report) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
